title: 小倉記念の後に・メッキでも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature gains a little bit of confidence after she answers the cheers of the people from Kokura's shopping district with a great race result.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this confidence, Nice Nature aspires to run in the Kikuka Sho to challenge Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before leaving Kokura the following day, I give Nice Nature a handmade origami trophy as a token of her growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature seems to be touched by the gesture, and states that she will do her best in the next race.
